description: This Java class 'LoanTransactionReadService' provides methods to fetch loan transactions by type or list of types, using JPA Criteria API for database queries within the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanTransactionReadService
classes.description: Service class for reading loan transactions from the database, with methods to fetch transactions by type or list of types.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionsByType
methods.description: Fetches loan transactions for a specific loan ID and external ID filtered by a single transaction type.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionsByTypes
methods.description: Fetches loan transactions for a specific loan ID and external ID filtered by a list of transaction types, ordered by date, creation date, and ID.
